value.title: The Battle of Bouvines (painting)

value.title: Battle of Bouvines
value.snippet: The Battle of Bouvines took place on 27 July 1214 near the town of Bouvines in the County of Flanders. It was the concluding battle of the Anglo-French

value.title: Angevin Empire
value.snippet: Anglo-French War (1213–1214) by Philip II of France following the Battle of Bouvines. John lost control of most of his continental possessions, apart from Guyenne
